title: Register Azure AD app and grant the Service Principal Fabric workspace access
description: Register an Azure AD application, create a client secret, and grant its Service Principal Contributor access to the OEMMatInsightBI Fabric workspace. Record the tenant ID, client ID and secret for use as GitHub repository secrets in task-046. Prerequisite for any automated deployment — fabric-cicd authenticates as this principal, not as a user.
acceptanceCriteria: An Azure AD app registration exists with a client secret whose expiry date is recorded.
Its Service Principal has at least Contributor access on Fabric workspace 99e4cc6d-6ec3-49a7-aed9-b69b04a97aa9.
Tenant ID, client ID and secret are captured somewhere outside the repo (never committed — see rules/archiving.md § Credentials).
Fabric tenant setting 'Service principals can use Fabric APIs' is confirmed enabled for the relevant security group.
notes: CREATED 2026-07-29 by /work task-spec coherence audit. Spec § Next Steps & Priorities defines Phase 4 (CI/CD Deployment) with concrete deliverables, but the project had zero Phase 4 tasks — verified by a grep probe with a positive control. This task is part of the 4-task set that closes that coverage gap.
HUMAN-ONLY: requires Azure portal and Fabric admin-portal access Claude does not have.

GOTCHA: a Fabric trial capacity has no Azure subscription, so the app registration is created at tenant level. This is the same constraint behind the existing `az login --allow-no-subscriptions` note in memory.
NEVER commit the client secret. It belongs in GitHub Actions secrets (task-046), not in parameter.yml.
